title: Professional Story Across Artifacts
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting professional story across artifacts to presentation storyboard with audience constraint and slide-level evidence, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the presentation storyboard with audience constraint and slide-level evidence shows a defensible decision in CAT 100.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
